text:
olivia: quick design review — deeplink handoffs between sidebar groups and breadcrumbs. noticed a weird back-button flow: open model from /models/hosted/xyz then breadcrumb shows Models > All Models > Hosted and hitting back jumps two levels. anyone else seen this?
sam: yep seen it in staging. root cause seems to be that breadcrumb is computed from current nav tree, not from the canonical route the deeplink intended.
jon: agree. thought: deep links should land on a canonical nav contract so breadcrumb and sidebar selection come from the same source.
lee: what would canonical look like? adding more path segments or query params? worried about breaking existing links.
maria: accessibility concern — when arriving via a deep link we should move focus to the main heading and ensure the breadcrumb has `aria-current="page"`. will add checklist. @a11y-bot any quick tips?
a11y-bot: checklist: 1) breadcrumb container uses `role="navigation"`. 2) mark active crumb with `aria-current="page"`. 3) on deep link arrival, set focus to the page heading and call `announce()` if needed. 4) ensure skip link target exists.
olivia: proposal: canonical routes like `/nav/:navId/resource/:resourceId` where navId is a stable sidebar id. this lets the router pick the exact sidebar item and generate breadcrumbs deterministically.
sam: navId idea seems clean. example legacy mapping: `/models/:group/:id` -> redirect client-side to `/nav/nav-models-hosted/resource/:id`. prefer redirect over duplicating breadcrumb logic.
jon: small implementation note: keep breadcrumb generation in a single util `buildBreadcrumbs(navId, resource)` used by both router and breadcrumb component. reduces divergence.
lee: i'll prototype a mapping layer: router reads `navId`, resolves sidebar config (by id), then selects that node. fallback path: if navId missing/invalid, open the search modal with `?openSearch=true`.
maria: copy/accessibility nit — update docs examples to show canonical deeplink pattern and include the focus behavior. also add a short note about preserving `target=_blank` semantics for external deep links.
olivia: quick example in case it's useful:
Proposed routes:
- `/nav/:navId/resource/:resourceId`
- legacy `/models/:group/:id` -> redirect to `/nav/nav-models-hosted/resource/:id`
Example final URL: `/nav/nav-models-hosted/resource/abc123?openSearch=false`
Implementation action items:
- lee: prototype router + mapping PR by EOD Thu
- sam: update console docs with deep link examples and add redirect guidance
- maria: embed ARIA checklist and focus handling in design spec
- jon: extract breadcrumb util and add unit tests
We'll sync on Friday to review POC. :thumbsup:
